domainScope.name: Carbon Actual Domain Circumference Contract
domainScope.purpose: Define the full scope of any domain/product before implementation: from smallest participant or unit to institutions, infrastructure, markets, intelligence, tools, lifecycle, geography, time and frontier.
domainScope.nonredundancy: This is a scope method, not a new constitutional primitive. It composes existing identity, authority, intent, capability, relationship, event, evidence, state and value semantics.
domainScope.geographic_depth: World -> country/territory -> first-level subdivision -> second-level subdivision -> locality/site/address/grid -> jurisdiction overlays. Administrative structures vary by place and must be source-grounded rather than assumed.
domainScope.temporal_depth: Historic -> current -> scheduled/planned -> emerging -> future -> simulated/possible -> unknown. Reality state must never be inferred from the existence of a record.
domainScope.openness_depth: Open -> public but authenticated -> member-only -> institutional -> restricted -> private/proprietary -> unavailable/unknown. Discovery is distinct from access.
domainScope.technology_depth: Web -> app -> SaaS -> API -> SDK -> CLI -> plugin -> MCP -> A2A -> agent -> swarm -> model -> protocol -> infrastructure -> dataset -> knowledge graph -> physical interface.
domainScope.organization_depth: individual -> household -> team -> club -> association -> cooperative -> startup -> SME -> enterprise -> corporation -> nonprofit -> institution -> professional body -> federation -> regulator -> government -> intergovernmental/global body.
domainScope.market_depth: need -> discovery -> listing -> quote -> bid/offer -> match -> order -> contract -> execution -> clearing -> settlement -> custody/delivery -> reconciliation -> dispute -> reporting -> learning.

domain_requirements.education: Cover early childhood/creche through primary, secondary, vocational/technical, tertiary, postgraduate/doctoral, professional education, continuing education/CPD, executive education, lifelong/non-formal/informal learning, emeritus/retired academic continuity and all supporting services, actors, institutions, credentials, assessments and career transitions.
domain_requirements.professional_body: Cover prospect/member lifecycle, membership grades, education/CPD, exams, assessment, interview, invigilation/proctoring, credentialing, accreditation, ethics, disciplinary processes, branches, committees, events, dues, advocacy, research, publications, fellowship/honours, leadership and alumni/retirement continuity.
domain_requirements.market: Cover every market structure and venue relevant to the domain, including primary/secondary, centralized/decentralized, OTC, auction, tender, P2P, platform, procurement, labor, property, commodity, energy, financial, digital-asset, data, attention, service, capability, capacity, rights and emerging/future markets.
domain_requirements.management: Cover strategy, governance, administration, people, workforce, finance, treasury, sales, marketing, customer/service operations, product, project/program/portfolio, procurement, vendors, supply chain, assets, facilities, inventory, capacity, quality, risk, compliance, legal, data, knowledge, security, incidents, continuity, change, performance and decision support.

domainScope.ai_and_intelligence: Every domain can expose information, research, analysis, recommendation, prediction, planning, automation, agents, teams, swarms and missions. Intelligence may inform or execute only within the authority model.
domainScope.implementation_rule: A product is not considered substantially built until its domain circumference has been mapped, shared capabilities identified, source/provider universe catalogued, authority boundaries recorded, Supabase structures populated and release tests defined.
